status: Frozen before public benchmark retrieval scores are inspected; no model/cutoff selected
heldOutRule: Do not compute test retrieval scores until model/policy candidates and calibration conclusions are recorded. These test queries may have appeared in upstream training; training overlap is unknown.
models: pinned MedEmbed FP32 plus numerically checked finite-mask CoreML candidate
queryInput: Original query, no invented expansion or instruction prefix. Reject overlong native queries explicitly rather than truncate them.
documentInput: Use complete bounded production-prepared excerpts with the same title prefix as HybridLibrarySearch. Retain all windows. Stop and report any index exclusion/limit; do not evaluate a silent corpus prefix.
rankingScope: Offline model-only full-corpus diagnostic. Document score is maximum similarity across its prepared passage windows. This does not reproduce keyword fusion, four-passage selection or the12-second live app budget.
cutoffInvestigation: Report dev score distributions and fixed grids, preserving no-cutoff ranking. No old0.42 cutoff is assumed transferable. Candidate cutoffs remain research values until no-match/non-health and end-to-end app checks are also complete.
smallDiagnostic: Original nine cases remain development probes, not held-out validation. Retain known misses and all unexpected selections.
dataRetention: Keep archive/file hashes, split IDs, exact protocol, outcomes and failures in Git. Keep corpus/query text and temporary vectors outside the repository; do not redistribute raw dataset contents.
limits: Public relevance judgments do not establish medical truth or clinical suitability
Incomplete judgments may count useful unjudged results as unexpected
Upstream training/test overlap has not been audited
Mac timings do not establish physical-iPhone performance
No new app model, cutoff, inference policy or clinical claim is shipped by this diagnostic
candidateRankingGate: Before app integration, dev nDCG@10 should improve by at least0.02 absolute without Precision@4 worsening by more than0.02; any exception requires an explicit tradeoff before test scoring. No-match, non-health, exact-identifier and runtime gates remain independently necessary.
